name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 80 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 50 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-12-25, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.82 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
